provenance.copied: Verbatim from a captured real addon response (StremThru's extractor tests) or from the SDK docs. Account tokens were already replaced with x's by the source.
provenance.derived: Exact output format of that addon's current formatter code (linked), applied by hand to an invented release. Hashes, hosts and sizes are invented.
provenance.invented: Shape from the SDK docs or stremio-core types; content invented.

_meta.expect: Hand-labelled parse a good parser should produce from name + description/title + behaviorHints.filename. hdr uses DV, HDR10+, HDR10, HDR, SDR; audio uses atmos, truehd, dts-hd-ma, dts-x, dts, ddp, dd, aac; availability is cached | uncached | p2p | direct | external | youtube | usenet. size.bytes uses size.base. Review before treating as golden.
_meta._fixture: Every stream carries a _fixture key; strip it before feeding a parser that rejects unknown keys.
_meta.scrubbed: Path segments that look like account keys (20+ key-like characters, or runs of x placeholders, but not 40-character info hashes) and key/token/apikey query values are replaced with KEY.
